description: Connect a sheet-backed character to a scene without requiring paired place evidence. This outcome-level workflow records character-only scene evidence in SQLite first, refreshes project backups after commit, and regenerates scene sidecar characters/places only as generated compatibility output from canonical indexes. Canonical IDs are preferred; unambiguous case-insensitive scene titles, character names, and ID variants are resolved to canonical IDs before mutation. Ambiguous or suggested-only matches fail without mutating state.

character_id.description: Sheet-backed character present in the scene. Prefer canonical character_id; an unambiguous case-insensitive character_id or character name in this project/universe scope is also accepted.

note.description: Optional review note explaining the evidence. Stored in operation history, not in compatibility sidecars.

scene_id.description: Scene that provides the evidence. Prefer canonical scene_id; an unambiguous case-insensitive scene_id or unique scene title in this project is also accepted.

name: connect_scene_character_evidence
